overall_goal: Fry the chopped onions in an oiled pan until golden

goals.description: Retrieve the frying pan and place it on the hob
goals.rationale: The person takes the frying pan from the cupboard, removes its padding, and sets it on the stove.

goals.description: Add oil and transfer the chopped onions into the frying pan
goals.rationale: The person pours sunflower oil into the pan and then slides the chopped onions from the chopping board into it.

goals.description: Begin stirring the onions and turn on the extractor fan
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a spatula to stir the onions and break up chunks, while also turning on the extractor hood.

goals.description: Adjust the heat and continue frying and stirring the onions
goals.rationale: The person manages the cooking process by adjusting the hob temperature and repeatedly stirring the onions to ensure even frying.
